description:
Five years as an idol trainee. I failed the audition program, then I return to school.

Aerobics? Please leave me alone! I want to live quietly now!

The aerobics club like that said they will grant my wish. The requirement is to enter the aerobics competition! And somehow, I had to aim for the championship. Can we, who are still awkward and newbies, do well?
